executedPrompt: 현재 Abundance Access에 ① 국가·연도·지표를 보존하는 공유 링크 ② 선택한 국가들의 세 지표가 모두 있는 최신 공통 연도 찾기 ③ 출처와 계산 근거가 연결된 관측 요약·노트 저장을 추가한다. 결측값을 채우거나 원인을 추정하지 않는다. 핵심 흐름을 실행·검증한 뒤 GitHub Pages에 반영한다.
reviewBasis: Three independent project reviews using verifiable evidence, limits and practical reproducibility as criteria. Not a review, prediction of opinion, or endorsement by Yorke Rhodes.

findings: Saved evidence from a different snapshot needed a visible warning.
CSV omitted retained rawFile, rawRow and sourceUpdatedAt fields.
Saved calculations needed indicator-specific interpretation limits.
fixes: Added saved-note snapshot mismatch and restore-use explanation.
Exported original raw references and source update fields, with regression checks.
Displayed the indicator limitation with recorded arithmetic; completeness explicitly means availability.

reviews.focus: Research workflow, work preservation and visible feedback
findings: A conflicting draft was preserved, but its notice could remain off screen after clicking the calculation transfer button.
Browser regression detected a chart result below the viewport after changing the indicator.
fixes: Opened the unchanged existing notebook draft and showed its conflict notice in view.
Kept the changed chart and its result visible when needed, without animation or moving keyboard focus.

reviews.focus: Reproducibility and handoff to a new visitor
checks: Only five allowed selection/snapshot fields are shared; existing notes remain private.
Different snapshots are not silently substituted.
Recorded 2022 evidence retains its values, year, snapshot and source links while the current view changes to 2025.
fixes: Updated verification counts and documented snapshot availability limits.
reviews.status: no blocking defect found in reviewed scope

verification.browserExecution: 38-case full suite plus 2 newly added copy-success/stale-filter cases; CI runs all 40 together.
verification.mcp: Actual local stdio handshake, four tools, two protocol modes and shared-snapshot equality passed.

limits: External statistics are not independently proven accurate by these code checks.
A shared link does not fetch archived snapshots; original values are reproduced only while that snapshot is available.
Country averages and differences do not establish causes or educational effects.
No Sayari data, paid service, account setup or LLM call was added.
Source collection timestamp and manual metadata review date remain unchanged.
